title: Search GitHub issues and pull requests with AI
h1: find github issues and pull requests by asking
description: Turn a question into a focused GitHub issue or pull request search. Use repository and status qualifiers, inspect matches and report incomplete results.
keywords: github search pull requests with ai
claude find github issues and pull requests
answer: **someone may have solved that bug before you lost the morning to it.** a bot searches github issues and pull requests by repository, author, label or status. it brings back matches and the search words it used. start in the repository where the error happens, then read the closest report for symptoms and affected versions.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: search with the repository in view.
what:
**find the earlier investigation before starting yours from scratch.** describe the error and name the repository. the bot combines words with filters for people, labels and open or closed work. say whether you want issues, pull requests or both.

it can sort matches and fetch more results. have it open the promising reports: a closed issue helps only if the fix covers your version.
uses: **avoid a duplicate report.** look for closed issues about the same error first.
**see what might fix it next.** find open pull requests that mention your component.
**cover a teammate.** find their assigned issues before they leave for holiday.

routine.message:
every tuesday at 9, search larchstone-dev/atlas for open issues and pull requests mentioning "export timeout".

- show the search words and repository
- group matches into issues and pull requests
- read promising matches before calling them the same problem
- say if unread results or search limits leave gaps

return the report here. never label, close, assign or comment on anything.
routine.needs: github connected with read only; allow search and reading matched issues or pull requests
routine.output:
larchstone-dev/atlas
search: repo:larchstone-dev/atlas state:open "export timeout"
issue #47: large exports time out.
pull request #52: retry change; needs a closer read.
no repository changes.

steps: **keep it read only.** connect github for this search bot.
**name the search area.** give the owner, repository and error phrase. choose issues, pull requests or both.
**inspect a match.** ask for the search wording and any gaps beside the results.
**keep the investigation on your radar.** schedule the search, then change the question as the problem narrows.
watch: **private work needs access.** a repository your account cannot open will not appear.
**finish the search before ruling out an earlier report.** accessible repositories can still hit github search limits. ask the bot to show any gaps.
**find out whether the fix reached your version.** open the closed issue and read the affected versions.

faq.q: can it search only pull requests?
faq.a: **yes, say pull requests only.** have it show the exact search wording beside the matches.

faq.q: does no result mean nobody reported it?
faq.a: **try a different error phrase before giving up.** wording, repository access and search limits can hide an earlier report. have the bot name any gaps.

steps: name one repository and an error phrase
ask for issues and pull requests separately
open the closest report and compare the symptoms

mistakes.fix: start where the error happens. widen the search if that finds nothing.

mistakes.mistake: calling a similar title a duplicate
mistakes.fix: read the symptoms and affected version before joining the reports.

items: same symptoms, not just the same title
the bot read the report, not just the search result
any access or search gaps appear in the answer

tip.text: ask for the search words with the results. it is the quickest way to spot the wrong scope.
